final: WITH operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, SUM(scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS all_operator_avg FROM operator_stats) SELECT AVG(o.total_scans) AS avg_total_scans, AVG(o.avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute, AVG(o.avg_gb_per_minute - b.all_operator_avg) AS avg_margin FROM operator_stats AS o CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE o.avg_gb_per_minute > b.all_operator_avg
